fact: The Ministry of Finance's April 2026 end evaluation of the PFM Strategy 2021-2025 lists a revenue administration reform in which Basse Area Council embarks on a Digital Tax Collection System (e-payment), and states the planned integration of the DTCS with IFMIS has not been achieved across councils.
title: End Evaluation Report of the Public Finance Management Strategy (PFM) 2021-2025
publisher: Ministry of Finance and Economic Affairs
